traits.description: Traits are key/value pairs received from an identity provider (through OIDC claims or SAML assertions) or from a system administrator for local accounts. Traits are used to populate role variables.

trusted_device_ids.description: TrustedDeviceIDs contains the IDs of trusted devices enrolled by the user.  Note that SSO users are transient and thus may contain an empty TrustedDeviceIDs field, even though the user->device association exists under the Device Trust subsystem. Do not rely on this field to determine device associations or ownership, it exists for legacy/informative purposes only.  Managed by the Device Trust subsystem, avoid manual edits.
